explicit_validation.explanation: The paper explicitly validates LLM evaluation against human judgments by comparing scores on the same summaries and reporting quantitative correlation metrics (Spearman, Kendall Tau) for all 7 dimensions.

prompts.notes: Prompt structure described with 3 components (Task Description, Evaluation Criteria, Evaluation Steps). Partial example shown for Aspect Coverage dimension in main text. Full prompts likely in Appendix C (mentioned but not visible in provided text).

guidelines.notes: Detailed scoring rubrics provided for all 7 dimensions including specific instructions for penalizing summaries. Two-round annotation process with rating scale 1-5.

sample_size.notes: 32 products × 13 summaries = 416 total instances evaluated by both LLM and human raters

correlation_interpretation.threshold_used: Not explicitly stated, but 0.70 described as showing high correlation

validation_results.summary_finding: OP-I-PROMPT achieves average Spearman correlation of 0.70 with human judgments, significantly outperforming prior approaches and showing LLMs can reliably approximate human evaluation for opinion summaries.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation used identical 7 evaluation dimensions on the same set of summaries
